sloka: सा भीम वेगा समर अभिकांक्षिणीसुदारुणा राक्षस वीर सेना ।तौ राज पुत्रौ सहसा अभ्युपेतामाला ग्रहाणाम् इव चन्द्र सूर्यौ ॥३-२३-३४॥
transliteration: sā bhīma vegā samara abhikāṁkṣiṇīsudāruṇā rākṣasa vīra senā ।tau rāja putrau sahasā abhyupetāmālā grahāṇām iva candra sūryau ॥3-23-34॥

translations.english: Similarly Dusana proceeded with four Mahakapali, Sthulaksha, Pramathi and Trisira around him.
